prompt:
Create ONE production-quality 2D inventory/equipment sprite: Njohrr's isolated complete waist armor from Predator: Badlands, based closely on the supplied official Hot Toys MMS863 reference photographs. This is an empty wearable belt-and-tasset assembly, NOT a character. Use reference 1 (close-up) as the exact design guide, reference 2 (full-body official photograph) to confirm proportions, and reference 3 only for the existing game's realistic painted asset rendering and material clarity. Do NOT copy reference 3's different Kwei design.
Design to preserve from refs 1–2: a broad dark burgundy-brown pebbled leather waist belt; three overlapping rounded leather hip lames on EACH side, stepped downward and outward, with subtle incised diagonal/crosshatched lines on the small top lame; one long rectangular brown pebbled leather front flap with rounded lower corners; a bronze central layered chevron/leaf-shaped metal tasset over this flap, with three elongated nested tapering pointed plates; a small elongated bronze crest/buckle at the top with tiny inset red accents, as seen in the close-up. Match the silhouette, overlap arrangement, proportions and restrained worn dark bronze/brown palette. Preserve the brown leather texture; do not turn it into bright red cloth. All visible components must belong to this waist armor.
Present the entire assembly in a near-frontal shallow three-quarter view, empty and slightly open at the waist so its wearable volume reads. The rear arc and tiny visible interior may be completed simply in plain dark leather without new ornament; no invented elaborate fastening. Both side tassets and the entire central flap must be fully visible within the frame. Keep all points fully inside the canvas with generous 10% transparent margin. No body, no legs, no hands, no torso armor, no cape, no chain dangling from the chest, no sword, no stand, no labels or text. Do not include the floor or background from the photos.
Art direction: highly detailed 2D digitally painted realistic game equipment sprite, crisp readable edges, controlled microtexture, worn materials, broad soft neutral illumination from upper left, restrained highlights, subtle self-shadow only. Match the realistic isolated equipment asset in reference 3 in finish, not its design. Center the object on a square canvas. True transparent RGBA background, with actual alpha outside the object; no checkerboard, solid fill, external shadow, vignette, glow, or scenery. One isolated sprite only, no sheet, no alternate angles.
